records.title: Order source XOR
records.decision: Exactly one approved source variant must match its discriminator and required source/participant facts. Platform screening uses its distinct approved source with no fake Professional seller. Enforce both domain validation and database constraints in the coordinated schema slice; nullable foreign keys alone do not enforce the invariant. Exact SQL/constraint layout is deferred; existing rows require provenance and conflict review before migration.
records.activation_gate: Database posture D plus coordinated representation/fixture/replay qualification; no blanket feature activation.

Retain nullable legacy storage until existing rows are inventoried and validated. Add requiredness only through the coordinated preservation migration; never guess a buyer from arbitrary User data.

records.title: BookingHold lock relation
records.decision: BookingSlotLock.bookingHoldId is the authoritative hold-to-lock relation. Do not require or independently write both relation paths. Treat BookingHold.lockId only as a legacy compatibility value to compare/quarantine before cleanup. Ordinary lock conversion produces at most one Booking; Order multiplicity uses separate authorized sessions/locks.

records.title: Live URL compatibility
records.decision: Persisted roomUrl and join URL fields may contain only non-authorizing metadata or opaque references. Participant credentials are issued on demand for current parent/room generation and actor/time scope; reusable plaintext bearer credentials are prohibited. Inventory legacy contents securely and quarantine unsafe values before reuse. Removal/repurposing/encryption design is a coordinated physical task; encryption alone does not make a reusable credential authoritative.
records.activation_gate: Database posture D plus coordinated representation/fixture/replay qualification; no blanket feature activation.

records.title: Course identity redundancy
records.decision: CourseDetails.offeringId is canonical identity; CourseVideoAsset.courseDetailsId identifies that course/Offering. Any retained redundant offeringId must equal it. Validate through Video owner facts; mismatch denies the affected association and is quarantined for repair. Choose removal or durable equality constraint in the coordinated migration, without changing identity semantics.
records.activation_gate: Database posture D plus coordinated representation/fixture/replay qualification; no blanket feature activation.

records.title: Immutable policy representation
records.decision: Each upload attempt binds an immutable policy revision and exact historical policy content/identity with effective context/time selection. Activated policy revisions are immutable; new policy changes create new revisions. SH-080 supplies versioning mechanics while Media owns policy meaning. Physical columns/constraints follow the coordinated convention; mutable updatedAt or context/status uniqueness is insufficient historical proof.
records.activation_gate: Database posture D plus coordinated representation/fixture/replay qualification; no blanket feature activation.

records.title: Upload attempt state
records.decision: Use dedicated upload-attempt state separate from MediaAsset status: initiated, uploading, uploaded, validating, required scanning/processing, completed; failed/rejected/cancelled/expired terminate an attempt. Terminal retries create linked attempts. Provider success cannot bypass required stages. Exact enum/columns and legacy mapping are deferred to coordinated migration; unknown legacy values cannot be inferred ready.
records.activation_gate: Database posture D plus coordinated representation/fixture/replay qualification; no blanket feature activation.
